claim: The sample demo uses a separate demo: storage key and does not change real profile data.
sandbox: fresh browser context; seed a non-demo sentinel; change and reset the demo; inspect every localStorage key

claim: Text size ranges from 100% to 180% and line spacing ranges from 1.2x to 2x while controls remain usable.
sandbox: fresh demo; set both maximums; inspect computed reading text and operate sample controls

claim: A profile returns on reload and can be paused to restore the original view.
sandbox: fresh demo; change profile; reload; pause; inspect restored sample text

claim: A profile can be exported as JSON.
sandbox: fresh demo; download and parse the generated JSON; assert profile, site, and setting values

claim: The demo sends no page text, form values, analytics events, or profile settings to another origin.
where: home privacy section, privacy notice, README
sandbox: capture every request during demo load, adjustment, and reset; require same-origin only

claim: The sample profile can be used without an account.
sandbox: fresh demo; complete an adjustment with no login or credential fields

claim: The demo and extension download require no purchase.
sandbox: fresh home page; request the extension ZIP; assert demo and download links exist and no checkout exists

claim: The installed sample demo reloads offline after its first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser; install service worker online; switch context offline; reload demo

claim: Profiles offer site, warm paper, high contrast, and night colors.
sandbox: fresh packaged Chromium extension; apply each color treatment to a fixture and assert the computed page colors

claim: An enabled cursor ring follows the pointer and keyboard focus.
sandbox: fresh packaged Chromium extension; enable the ring; move the pointer; then Tab to a link and assert the visible ring position changes

claim: Holding Alt+Shift+M enlarges keyboard focus, and releasing the keys restores it.
sandbox: fresh packaged Chromium extension; focus a bounded reading region; hold the shortcut; assert enlargement; release and assert restoration

claim: Password and common payment fields keep their original styles at the maximum 180% profile scale.
sandbox: fresh Chromium profile with packaged extension and local page containing password, payment, card, CVC, CVV, and autocomplete fields

claim: The extension stores profiles and site assignments in Chromium extension storage.
where: home privacy section, privacy notice, README
sandbox: fresh packaged Chromium extension; save an assigned profile and inspect chrome.storage.local
fresh packaged Chromium extension; inspect manifest permissions and apply a local profile without sign-in

claim: The extension includes no analytics scripts or third-party runtime scripts.
sandbox: fresh packaged extension; inspect emitted JavaScript and capture all HTTP requests while a profile activates

claim: The extension applies reversible visual reading settings in your browser.
sandbox: fresh packaged Chromium extension; apply a profile, observe changed reading text, remove it, and observe baseline restored

claim: The extension applies a profile only to its assigned site address.
sandbox: fresh packaged Chromium extension; assign 127.0.0.1 and verify localhost remains unchanged

claim: Applying an extension profile makes no remote request.
sandbox: fresh Chromium profile with packaged extension; capture target-page traffic while a local profile activates; require fixture origin only
